blurb: Located on the Detroit River between Lake St. Clair and Lake Erie, the Riverside Marina is southeast Michigan’s premier marine facility. Riverside Marina, originally Harbor Hill Marina, was the vision of Coleman A. Young and Portfield Wilson.
